verdict.rationale: Hands-on probes confirm a live llms.txt at docs.cekura.ai (HTTP 200, with a product summary). Doc pages are also served as markdown (.md), and each one points agents to the llms.txt index. A machine-readable openapi.json is reachable, and a dedicated guide covers using Cekura from AI coding agents like Claude Code, Cursor and Copilot. missing for 10: no evidence of an llms-full.txt or similar full-content dump, and no independent or community corroboration of agents actually consuming these docs.
